$comment: Information architecture of the React/Vite clone of the DL portfolio. Section ids match design-repo/sections/*.json. Case templates are grouped by the blocks a case actually uses (computed from src/data/site.json); the design-repo models all of them as one template family (template.case-study) with a free body slot. This is the only hand-edited file: IA.md and matrix.csv are generated by build.mjs.

meta.source: React/Vite clone of the DL portfolio (src/), routes from src/lib/router.js + src/data/site.json
meta.generatedBy: ia-builder skill, derived from the clone source and its measured render (design-repo/extraction/measured-values.json)

categories.SHELL: Site-wide frame present on every route: fixed header and the yellow footer.
categories.UTILITY: Runtime UI that is not page content: intro preloader, route-transition masks, modal, floating back control, password gate.
categories.INDEX: The home page's list of projects and its hand-drawn introduction.
categories.MEDIA: Image-, video- and screen-led case-study blocks.
categories.LAYOUT: Out-of-flow background treatments that frame other blocks.
categories.NAVIGATION: In-page links onward to another case.
categories.CONVERSION: Invitations to contact the site owner.

shell.header.description: Fixed top bar: three-part logo mark and owner name on the left, three underlined text links centred (work, book, LinkedIn), yellow pill CTA with animated arrow on the right; the links fade out after 50px of scroll.

shell.footer.description: Yellow gradient footer: large statement with a white-underlined word, next-availability date, three contact links, legal line and logo, with a 3D mascot behind; content parallaxes upward as it scrolls in.

utility.preloader.description: Black first-load overlay: a yellow ring draws, the logo's three parts pop in and fall away, then the page's physics start.
utility.preloader.scope: Mounted on all 11 routes, but only shown on the first load of a session.

utility.page-transition.description: Full-viewport masks used only while changing route: a black wipe, or (from the home list) a white wipe after the clicked project image falls.
utility.page-transition.scope: Present on all 11 routes; invisible at rest.

utility.video-modal.description: Dialog that Flip-animates a portrait video card to the centre, with a scrub track, timecode, cursor-following play/pause and a close button.

utility.back-button.description: Fixed bottom-left yellow circle with an arrow and a 'back' label linking to the home list; the label hides after the first scroll and the circle shrinks away near the footer.

utility.password-gate.description: Centred pill password field with a yellow submit circle and an inline error message, shown before a protected case renders.

hero.home.description: Dark opener: a discipline statement with a yellow full stop, a scroll cue, dark geometric physics shapes and a falling portrait video card with a hand-drawn 'get to know me' callout.

hero.case.description: Light opener of a case: very large title with one highlighted word and a yellow full stop, a 'roles' label, a short description, accent-coloured physics shapes and the featured image falling inside a semicircle mask.

content.case-index-intro.description: Rotated, hand-drawn style note with a looping yellow stroke and arrow that introduces the project list.

content.case-index-item.description: One project in the home list: a number inside a drawn step shape, optional client logo, large title with a highlighted word, one-line description and a 'check it out' link; the featured image is revealed through an ellipse that follows the cursor. Repeats once per listed project (9 on the live data).
content.case-index-item.scope: Home page only (1 route), repeated per project.

conversion.connect.description: Large words of an invitation fall as physics bodies around a centred portrait video card, above a yellow pill 'message' button.

content.media-text.description: Half-width image on a grey fill beside a display title (highlighted word, yellow full stop), one or two large paragraphs and an optional underlined external link.
content.media-text.scope: 9 case routes (every case except the password-gated one).

content.title-text.description: Two-column block: display title on the left, up to three body paragraphs with highlighted words (one may be bold) on the right.

content.text.description: Single inset text block in one of three forms: a numbered step (number inside a drawn triangle above a paragraph), a one-line display statement with a yellow full stop, or a plain paragraph.
content.text.scope: Every case route (10 routes), usually several times per page.

media.image.description: Single image, either inset to the right or full width between the gutters; consecutive images overlap upward slightly.

media.video.description: Inset 16:9 muted looping video that plays only while it is on screen.

media.carousel.description: Full-bleed row of tall phone screens that is dragged sideways with the mouse, or scroll-snapped on touch.

layout.gray-band.description: Out-of-flow light grey background band that starts halfway down the block after it and runs to the next-case section.
layout.gray-band.scope: 7 case routes, at most once each.

navigation.next-case.description: White band linking to the next case: small title and pill button top-left while large lettered words and an arrow fall onto a rotated semicircle holding the next case's image.

templates.name: Case: video + carousels + images + grey band
Case: opening video then numbered images
Case: list of image + statement blocks
